HRA Analysis: COSMIC FLYER (10) looks one of the class runners in this field and comes up with a reasonable draw considering his racing pattern is generally to get back and run on. He was running on nicely late two starts ago when getting into third behind Rakasandy. HOT ROD HARRY (9) put in a much better run last time out when getting back and running on into fourth behind Betterthanfederer. He looks likely to get back again in this race and should be running on late. PUNTERS JEWEL (8) should get a good run through in the early stages of this race on the back of a gate speed horse. He secured a good run last time out and wasn’t beaten far in a race taken out by Beyond Doubt. He should get his chance in this race. ULTIMATE ARK (1) was able to lead four starts ago at Redcliffe when leading for a long way rating good time himself when being run down by Western Bill. He can look to lead again in this race and should be hard to run down. SELECTIONS: COSMIC FLYER (10), HOT ROD HARRY (9), PUNTERS JEWEL (8), ULTIMATE ARK (1) SUGGESTED BET: PUNTERS JEWEL (8) each way.

BRAVENTREACHEROUS (12) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was able to show his brilliant turn of speed when flashing over the top to beat Miki B. He finds a race where there should be good early speed again which should see him very hard to hold out. FRENCH FRIES (11) was able to work to the lead last time out before being run down late by Darin who was a very good run in the Inter Dominion Consolation his start prior. He draws much less favourably this time and may be shuffled back or forced to do some work. CAPTAIN BART (5) returns to QLD in this race having done his recent racing in NSW. He got back and was running on late behind Magic Joe last time out. He has a draw advantage on a lot of his main rivals and may look to hold that. FIRE RAISER (7) broke through for another win last time out after being suited at Redcliffe by a genuine tempo when running over the top late. He may be shuffled back early given his lack of gate speed which could see him needing the race run upside down. SELECTIONS: BRAVENTREACHEROUS (12), FRENCH FRIES (11), CAPTAIN BART (5), FIRE RAISER (7) SUGGESTED BET: BRAVENTREACHEROUS (12) to win.

RUBY RULES (3) should have the speed to work forward and find the front in this race. She worked to the lead last time out and was able to beat her stablemate there REDS ABLAZE (1). With the barrier draw advantage on her stablemate COOL AND CLASSY (10) she should be hard to run down. COOL AND CLASSY (10) was one of QLDs many shining lights through the recent carnival when running a number of terrific races. She broke the track record at Redcliffe before then winning The Queensland Sun making her way into The Rising Sun and not having much luck there. She is likely to be put into the race at some stage and should run another good race REDS ABLAZE (1) should have the speed to lead before handing over to one of her more favoured stablemates. She secured a good run last time out at this track and ran a good second behind RUBY RULES (3). ISLA ROCHELLE (8) should get a good run through in this race and a good run on the pegs behind Reds Ablaze. She was running on nicely into third last start in a race taken out by Dessie Gee at Menangle. SELECTIONS: RUBY RULES (3), COOL AND CLASSY (10), REDS ABLAZE (1), ISLA ROCHELLE (8) SUGGESTED BET: RUBY RULES (3) to win.

PURE GRUNT (1) has excellent gate speed and should work through to lead this race in the early stages. He was very impressive last time out when leading at this track and winning easily over TIMMYTEO (7). He comes into this race third up for the stable of Donny Smith and may have derived benefit from his two latest outings. JAMES ALFRED (2) was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on gamely there for second behind IDEAL BRONSKI (11) given that isn’t usually how he is best suited in his races doing the work. He should get a good run close to the speed and can be running into it late. FIRE AND PASSION (6) has a poor draw in this race drawing outside of a number of the main chances in this race. He is a high quality horse and showed that through the recent carnival running second in the Redcliffe Derby and the Consolation of the Rising Sun. He should be able to work forward and race in a prominent position. IDEAL BRONSKI (11) was able to lead last time out and proved too good there for JAMES ALFRED (2). He is likely to be shuffled back in this race and will be relying on there being plenty of speed on to bring him into it. SELECTIONS: PURE GRUNT (1), JAMES ALFRED (2), FIRE AND PASSION (6), IDEAL BRONSKI (11) SUGGESTED BET: PURE GRUNT (1) to win.

MAYWYN SON OF LOU (2) should show enough gate speed to work through and lead again in this race. He led last start in the heat of this series and was able to run out a fairly comfortable winner over BET HES SWEET (6). He should be hard to beat. HUNT FOR GLORY (11) found the front in the heat of this series and was able to score a dominant win over IM EL ARQUERO (8). He draws poorly this time outside the back row but is a very smart horse and should still play a big part in this race whether he is put into the race or uses his high speed late. SAVAGE SEAS (5) is a talented horse which is still seemingly learning his racing craft. He got back from a wide draw last time out and was running into third nicely behind YIPPEE KIYAY (5). He should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. IM EL ARQUERO (8) drew poorly last time out and was running on well into second behind HUNT FOR GLORY (11). He should get a good run through early in this race and will be hard to hold out late with the perfect run in the race. SELECTIONS: MAYWYN SON OF LOU (2), HUNT FOR GLORY (11), SAVAGE SEAS (5), IM EL ARQUERO (8) SUGGESTED BET: MAYWYN SON OF LOU (2) to win.

STRIPES (7) is a very smart filly and despite the wide draw she should be able to work to the lead and should be incredibly hard to beat in this race. She was able to lead last time out at this track and scored a comfortable win there over Notions. She clearly looks hardest to beat in this race. RUBY RHAYNE BOW (2) has gate speed and should be able to get across to the pegs before handing over to her stablemate STRIPES (7). She was first up from a spell last time out and was able to lead all the way beatingAMYLEE (11). She looks to have strong place claims. AMYLEE (11) has been racing in good form and continues to be forced to do the work in her races. She was forced to do the work last time out and wasn’t beaten far there behind RUBY RHAYNE BOW (2). She may be forced to do the work again in this race and should run another good race. MISS BLUETRUMP (1) secured a good run close to the speed last time out and was running on strongly late into second behind GIRL POWER (12). She doesn’t have any gate speed which could see her shuffled back initially but she is racing well and looks to have place claims. SELECTIONS: STRIPES (7), RUBY RHAYNE BOW (2), AMYLEE (11), MISS BLUETRUMP (1) SUGGESTED BET: MISS BLUETRUMP (1) to place.

SHINE LIKE ME (2) added to her already impressive record last time out when leading and proving an easy winner over CHERRY SURPRISE (6). She draws well in this race and has very good gate speed which should see her finding the front early before being very hard to run down. MACKENZIE REG (1) was able to lead last time out and ran out a big winner there over LONG AWAITED (11). She comes up against a few better performed horses this time but is progressing which each run and should run another good race. FIT AND READY (9) sat without cover last time out and battled on well there for third behind SWEET LEAH JANE (7). She draws to follow out a gate speed horse in this race which should see her settling close enough. She can run well again. MULLUM SHOWGIRL (3) got back in the run last start and was hitting the line strongly late into second behind SWEET LEAH JANE (7). She should settle closer this time from a great draw and should be running into it late again. SELECTIONS: SHINE LIKE ME (2), MACKENZIE REG (1), FIT AND READY (9), MULLUM SHOWGIRL (3) SUGGESTED BET: SHINE LIKE ME (2) to win.

FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (5) scored a good win three starts ago at this track when sprinting up nicely to score a dominant win. He seems to be starting to put things together in his races. ICONIC IMAGE (8) ran a very good race two starts ago when starting off a 30 metre handicap and being beaten just 3.5 metres behind one of his key rivals in this race KICKING HORSE (9). He should get a good run through early and with luck at the right time he can be running into the finish. KICKING HORSE (9) didn’t have much go right for him last start when well beaten by talented former kiwi trotter Raffie Jay. He has options early in this race and third up from a spell should be nearing peak fitness. SERENA LOVE (1) has gate speed and is likely to drive through and be keen to hold a prominent position in this race. She led two starts ago at this track and was well beaten there but may be better suited with a sit in this race and can bounce back. SELECTIONS: FREDIDRIVSAMERCURY (5), ICONIC IMAGE (8),KICKING HORSE (9), SERENA LOVE (1) SUGGESTED BET: ICONIC IMAGE (8) to place.

PINNIE (6) started her career in QLD before moving down to Victoria where she has impressed scoring 10 wins. She is a FFA winner last start having beaten Inter Dominion runner Jilliby Dreamlover. She trialled reasonably and should be ready to run a good race. SQUAMISH (8) is a talented trotter that seems to be now putting his best foot forward and has been showing much better manners this campaign. He secured a good run two starts ago at this track and was able to run over the top and score. PHEONIX RED (9) returns to QLD for this race having had one Victorian start where he made a break and took no part. He has since trialled well enough for a race of this nature and should run well. NORTHERN HEIGHTS (7) wasn’t beaten too far last time out behind Love Gun who was dropping back in grade there. He draws widest this time and can do a few things wrong. If he brings his best manners he should run a good race. SELECTIONS: PINNIE (6), SQUAMISH (8), PHEONIX RED (9), NORTHERN HEIGHTS (7) SUGGESTED BET: SQUAMISH (8) place.

HILLDALE HILTON (5) was able to complete a hat-trick of wins last time out when scoring well at this track over Pozzi Tonozzi. If he can begin safely in this race he may be able to hold a draw advantage on his key rivals which could prove crucial to determining the result of the race. PHOENIX REX (9) is undefeated in three runs so far having on all three starts at Melton. His latest win came when not having much luck having to do plenty of work and just proved too good for Regal Gala and Miss Muscle. He looks hard to beat. IM FRANKEE (10) returned to QLD with a dominant win last time out after starting off a 20 metre handicap she was able to step nicely and power over them late. She meets these horses on equal terms this time but does bump into a few good ones. FRAZZLED (8) didn’t have much luck last start when badly checked. He has shown good ability so far in his career and could be a horse worth including at odds. SELECTIONS: HILLDALE HILTON (5), PHOENIX REX (9), IM FRANKEE (10), FRAZZLED (8) SUGGESTED BET: HILLDALE HILTON (5) to win. OVERVIEW:ROCKIN GEMMA (10) has her first start for the new stable and looks very well placed against her own sex, particularly with the concession claim. She punches through behind a very quick beginner, so she should map within striking distance. She showed some ability last preparation after coming to Victoria and, in her one trial for the Matt Horsnell camp, trialled very well against a couple of smart ones at Terang recently in a good tune-up for this. GOLD IN PARIS (6) partnered with James Herbertson for the first time and duly saluted last time out with gusto, beating home HUXHAM CHUBB (7), who was also very good as runner-up. That horse has since franked the form by winning at Charlton last Monday, and that pair appear the testing material, albeit from awkward draws. EASTBRO KAZ (11) is another benefiting from a concession in easier grade. She’s been racing against much better-quality opposition and can sweep home well with the right cover. QUICK CRUNCH (1) and MEGAWATTS (4) have hit a purple patch of form and are in the mix, while JILLIBY KYMY LOU (2) and TORQUE INTHEUSA (3) have the best speed and cut at each other last time, which could ensure a genuine tempo. BACK: ROCKIN GEMMA (10)– 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:ROCKIN GEMMA (10), GOLD IN PARIS (6), HUXHAM CHUBB (7), EASTBRO KAZ (11)

OVERVIEW: Very tricky affair, with the majority of these not winning out of turn. The experience of driver Michael Bellman is a major factor here from the positive draw, allowing him to press forward and look for the lead with MISSMALACHITE (3). She hasn’t had much luck with barrier draws and has been forced to work harder than she’d like, whereas the map and opposition here look favourable. Her last victory came back in April when she was able to find the top. ZWICK (4) can slide across with her and potentially map handy. He finds a better draw than he’s been used to and will also find this grade more to his liking. He’s also a winner at this track. YANKEE RAIN (7) stays under notice after switching to the Tom Rundle stable and has trialled okay leading into this, although the draw is a little tricky. BLISSFULL LILLY (5) was a winner when leading four starts back, so the map is important for her, while the draw for ICONMOTOR (2) helps him. They both have minor claims. SELECTIONS:MISSMALACHITE (3), ZWICK (4), YANKEE RAIN (7), ICONMOTOR (2)

OVERVIEW: Standing-start conditions for the trotters, where you can expect the likely leader after 600m to come from ALLAWART BOB (2), BROWN EYED KATE (3) and ITGETSBETTER (4), despite all being off 10 metres. However, those off the bigger handicaps have the better form. BOUTIKA (5) is one of those and will find this much more suitable than her last start at Melton. More compelling is the fact that the last time she started under standing-start conditions was at this track back in April, where she began well off the 20m handicap and beat her rivals easily. She looks well placed. JAKARTA (7) has regained some better form under standing-start conditions and won well off 30m back in July. Her starts since have been sound, so she must be considered. BARLINNE (6) ran second in that July win, and her past couple have looked tougher than this. Poor manners from the opposition bring the leaders ALLAWART BOB (2), BROWN EYED KATE (3) and ITGETSBETTER (4) into calculations, while backmarker SONAMI JOH (9) also ranks as a minor chance. BACK: BOUTIKA (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:BOUTIKA (5), JAKARTA (7), ITGETSBETTER (4), BARLINNE (6)

OVERVIEW: The inside four horses all like to show gate speed here, so the battle for the lead is very interesting, with three stablemates and DIRECT COMMAND (2) sandwiched in between them. With that in mind, I’m looking away from the leading division and expect sharp improvement from BACKBEACH PETER (7), who had nothing go right in his two recent runs in SA when failing as a short-priced favourite. I’m happy to overlook those and assess his prior performances, which were terrific. Most notable was a runner-up performance to Rocknroll Willow, who has since franked that form. GRINNING BEACH BOY (4) led from a better draw last time when second. He’s going to need things to work out, but Herbertson sticking with him is a major plus. DIRECT COMMAND (2) could be open to sharp improvement after coming up with his best draw in some time, and the last time he was able to find the top he was a winner back in June. FIVE CENT (5) gets another tricky draw but is racing honestly, as is PRECIOUS BELLE (6), who’s a get-back type. Both have minor claims. BACK: BACKBEACH PETER (7)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:BACKBEACH PETER (7), GRINNING BEACH BOY (4), DIRECT COMMAND (2), PRECIOUS BELLE (6)

OVERVIEW: Tricky affair with 2yos taking on 3yos and a few without exposed form. BAY LA VILLE (8) is a 3yo filly first-up without a trial, but what she displayed last preparation deserves respect. She won on debut, where she settled back in the field and found the line strongly, beating a reasonable field. At her next assignment in the Vicbred Super Series she underperformed and was thrown in the paddock. Whilst the fitness may not be there, the ability is. COCO MILLER (1) is a 2yo filly who has trialled very well leading into a race of this calibre. She’s stepped out three times and has won each of those trials, displaying good manners, while in her past two trials she was able to record a reasonable mile rate. The barrier draw means she maps well, and being on the peg line over the sprint trip is an advantage. RAVISHING ROXY (6) will appreciate getting back to age-assessed racing after two runs up in class this preparation, the most recent of which saw her run third. She’s mixed her gate speed, leading on occasions and beginning roughly in others, but she’s in the mix. SWEET LADY LOU (7) was able to win at her sixth start as a 2yo and found the line well from back and wide. She’s had the benefit of one run this preparation and hit the line okay in what was a stronger field than she meets here. The draw is a little tricky, however. SELECTIONS: BAY LA VILLE (8), COCO MILLER (1), RAVISHING ROXY (6), SWEET LADY LOU (7)

OVERVIEW: JILLIBY ECLIPSE (8) started a very short-priced favourite on debut and did everything wrong, galloping twice in the run when she was about to obtain a good position. She’s had two trials since then and showed marked improvement in her manners. She will no doubt be short odds again, courtesy of the power of the Lee stable alone, but tread warily given her manners. SHEER ME (5) comes here with different form, having her first start for the new stable after arriving from NSW. She’s a well-bred mare coming in without a trial, but keep her safe and watch the betting. SPORTY ROCKS (3) has run some decent races, placing twice, and should get a decent map in a race that doesn’t appear overly strong. JADES REASON (2) is a 2yo filly taking on the older horses, and she wasn’t too bad last time out at Globe Derby, sitting parked for the final lap against a reasonable field and battling to the line okay. The soft draw helps. SELECTIONS: JILLIBY ECLIPSE (8), SHEER ME (5), SPORTY ROCKS (3), JADES REASON (2)

OVERVIEW:IMALLATTITUDE (5) has been racing in terrific form lately and finds another suitable race to be a strong winning hope. Sectionally, he was terrific last start, narrowly missed with a flat tyre the start prior and was a winner three back when Luke Sutherland was aboard, who claims again here. Whilst he will be at the mercy of the right tempo in a small field, the way he’s been running on suggests he will be hard to hold out. PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (1) is a lightning-quick beginner and won’t be crossed from the pole. It depends on what tactics Jackie Barker wants to adopt from there, but either way he presents as the hardest to run down. IAMAWINGATE (2) was disappointing at Shepparton, but he always seems to come back into his best form when racing at this grade, and reuniting with Herbertson adds appeal, as he was the last driver to win on him. JUST LIKE NUGGET (4) finally broke through for his maiden win when given a perfect run; however, this map looks a little sticky if he’s to get a similar trip. BACK: IMALLATTITUDE (5)– 3.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: IMALLATTITUDE (5), PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (1), IAMAWINGATE (2), JUST LIKE NUGGET (4)

OVERVIEW: Problematic way to finish, with most of these clashing in a race at Ballarat two runs back, so there’s a form line there, but subsequently they’ve all performed poorly at their next outing. Hence why I want to look away from that race, and it leaves me with DOCTOR GO JOH (7), who comes into the race with the best national rating and will find this company much more suitable. He’s had to sit parked in fast times his past couple, times which this opposition is unlikely to be able to match. In his last win in June, he defeated a horse who won easily earlier in the week. SIR CANDY CLOUD (5) did burn early trying to find the lead last time out, so there are reasons to forgive that performance. Bellman jumps aboard for the first time and could assist in a change of form. ALLTHEWAYTOROYALTY (2) was good at his first run for the stable but then performed poorly at Mildura when he led and over raced as favourite. He could improve if he brings his best. DI ANGELO (4) hasn’t had the best passage in running his past couple and is familiar with this company, so he’s in the mix. SELECTIONS:DOCTOR GO JOH (7), SIR CANDY CLOUD (5), ALLTHEWAYTOROYALTY (2), DI ANGELO (4)

A No More Than Two Wins event kicks off tonight, where IDEN ELIZA JANE (1) will be looking to break through at start 17. She draws the pole and will be attempting to hold the front after a handy effort last start when sitting outside the leader. SOHO TIGER LILY (7) drops back in grade after competing in the Oaks last week and possesses terrific gate speed, so expect her to be driven aggressively from the outside gate in an attempt to find the pegs, where she may take plenty of running down over the mile. REMMINGTON (4) is a lightly raced six-year-old who won nicely at her first start in the state two starts back, and expect him to again push forward from the middle of the front row to give herself every chance. B K WINDERMERE (2) is the other front-row runner and resumes from a lengthy spell, but trialled nicely enough recently to suggest she can be competitive here. With good early speed expected, the back-row runners should also get their chance, including I GOTTA GO (9), who has been consistent throughout his career and battled on well after copping pressure throughout last start against older horses. MIRA DOMINA (10) narrowly went down when leading in fast time over the short trip last start and clearly appreciates the mile distance. Selections:SOHO TIGER LILY (7), I GOTTA GO (9), MIRA DOMINA (10), IDEN ELIZA JANE (1) Staking Strategy: There should be some good speed on early here, so I GOTTA GO gets his chance to run over the top late. 2 unit win – I GOTTA GO (9)

SWEET DIXIE (2) should have enough gate speed to find the pegs, which could make her difficult to run down. She was good first up from a break two weeks ago and gets into this race well with the mares claim. EYE SEE AMOUR (5) gets back to a front-row draw after his manners have let him down on a few occasions of late. However, if he puts his best foot forward and gets away cleanly, his class should take him a long way in this field. IDEN OLIVER (8) will again require some luck from the inside back-row draw but cannot be ruled out with clear running at the right time. KNOCK OUT (7) has been racing well without winning and, if able to secure a nice run in transit with some genuine tempo throughout, should be finishing off strongly. Selections:SWEET DIXIE (2), EYE SEE AMOUR (5), KNOCK OUT (7), IDEN OLIVER (8) Staking Strategy:SWEET DIXIE gets her chance to notch another victory next to her name. 2 unit win – SWEET DIXIE (2)

A standing-start event over 2090 metres, where the front-line runners generally get their chance to roll along. REPETITIVE (2) continues to drop back in grade after going winless from 27 attempts this season. If he can step cleanly, he could take plenty of running down at each-way odds. OLLIES MEDAL (4) clearly possesses ability but can be his own worst enemy, and once again his chances largely depend on how well he begins. If he steps safely and behaves throughout, he should be right in the finish. SPOOKY GIRL (6) made good late ground from the back of the field in a fast mile rate last start and, if able to find a position closer to the speed in this even field, should take plenty of beating. The handicapped runners are clearly the class horses of the race, although they will require sharp beginnings to make up ground early. ZEUS IMMORTAL (8) has competed well in recent four-year-old features and makes his first standing-start appearance here, while LAID BACK (9) has been racing extremely well without winning against stronger opposition and brings a clear class edge back to this grade. Selections:SPOOKY GIRL (6), LAID BACK (9), REPETITIVE (2), ZEUS IMMORTAL (8) Staking Strategy:SPOOKY GIRL just needs to replicate her last run to be a good each-way chance here. 1 unit each-way – SPOOKY GIRL (6)

A difficult race to assess, with a very even field engaged. WAZOWSKI (2) gets her chance to improve on recent form and looks capable of being the first runner to the pegs, which should give her every opportunity. Her stablemate IAMAHUNTER (1) should receive the perfect run behind the leader and gets his chance to utilise the sprint lane after competing in slightly stronger races at his past few starts. MY WAY (5) looks the other main gate-speed runner on the front row and is rarely far away in races of this grade. SHOOBEES SPIRIT (6) will be reliant on genuine tempo throughout but should be flying home late, as he usually does when saved for one run. DONNY IN PARIS (8) and CHAMONIX (9) get favourable back-row draws and, with the right luck in running, should both be finishing off strongly. Selections:IAMAHUNTER (1), MY WAY (5), SHOOBEES SPIRIT (6), WAZOWSKI (2) Staking Strategy:IAMAHUNTER gets the draw to improve here and should get his chance up the sprint lane. 1 unit win – IAMAHUNTER (1)

A low-class event over the mile where there looks to be good speed engaged early. COLORADO GIRL (1) will no doubt be looking to hold up from the pole draw. She was well backed when narrowly defeated over the short trip two starts ago before breaking during the run last start, and gets her chance to return to the winner's circle here with better manners. FEELINKINDALUCKY (4) will again be driven positively and may look to sit outside the pole marker and out-tough her, as she did two starts back. BARBETTE (3) somewhat drops back in grade following a handy second last start and should receive a nice run with cover, giving her every opportunity to be in the finish. COLBY ART (7) and STAROFREMEMBRANCE (8) will be relying on genuine tempo throughout to bring them into the race and should be running home strongly, as they usually do. QUEENOFDANCE (9) could be the one at each-way odds from a nice trailing draw, having bobbed up a couple of times recently in this grade. Selections:COLORADO GIRL (1), FEELINKINDALUCKY (4), BARBETTE (3), QUEENOFDANCE (9) Staking Strategy:BARBETTE looks to be the speed-map horse, possibly sitting one-one, and gets her chance to be winning. 2 unit win – BARBETTE (3)

The first of two small fields to round out the night is the higher-class event on the program, where IRON CLAD (4) and VANQUISH STRIDE (6) gain entry after not winning at their past eight starts. They hold a definite class edge over most of their opposition and would expect both to be fighting out the placings at worst. THE DEVILS FLAME (1) has been racing well since arriving in Tasmania after bringing competitive Victorian form across and gets every opportunity from the pole in the small field. He looks the most progressive runner engaged and could take plenty of holding out. MERRYWOOD PAUL (3) is racing better than his recent numerical form suggests and only needs to maintain those efforts to be highly competitive. The small field should suit after he has been making ground from the rear in recent starts. MISTA EAGLE (2) can never be ruled out in races of this nature and looks the runner most likely to pressure the pole marker early in search of the lead. ALWAYS AURORA (5) has not been on his best behaviour of late, but it would be no surprise to see him bob up and win if he puts his best foot forward. Selections:THE DEVILS FLAME (1), IRON CLAD (4), VANQUISH STRIDE (6), MERRYWOOD PAUL (3) Staking Strategy:THE DEVILS FLAME is the lowest-handicapped horse in the field but clearly has the most upside. Happy to side with him here. 2 unit win – THE DEVILS FLAME (1)

An absolute raffle to round out the night, where you would expect the entire field to start at single-figure odds. KENYA (5) will no doubt be driven aggressively from the outset, which is when he races at his best, and expect he may even bully his way to the front and take plenty of catching. ROSE NOIRE (2) produced an improved effort last start after joining the new stable and gets her chance to continue that progression. If she improves again, she could be very hard to hold out late. The other two old boys, DEBT TILL WE PART (4) and NO NUKES SKIPPER (6), have both bobbed up to win recently and certainly can't be ruled out in this grade. LALIBELA (3) possesses a sharp late sprint when there is genuine tempo throughout and could easily be in the finish if the race is run to suit. BRIGHTLY BLAZE (1) is a three-year-old filly taking on the older horses after returning to the state and, despite the rise in grade, it would be no surprise to see her win if she produces her best form. EAGLESTONE (2) and PLATINUMS SON (5) are also chances.

MAJESTIC SUMMER (6) finds a much easier race tonight compared to her recent assignments. The handicap will be a little tricky but she is good enough to win a race like this. HURRICANE JANE (2) looks like the main danger after an impressive last start win. THE CLIPPER (3) and DOUBLE JOEY (4) are also chances.

SHIRLEY NOT (6) doesn’t have the best draw tonight but her she ran a handy race last start behind OUR CHEEKY DEVIL. She looks ready to bounce back into the winners list today. MEET ME AT THE BEACH (2) is well drawn and she looks like the main danger. SWEET ARPEGGIO (4) and LUNCHINHEAVEN (1) are also chances.

BLINGADINGDING (5) did it tough from the second row last start at Gawler when he finished 5.6 meters behind COME ON BILLEE. LIGHTNING BLING (4) wasn’t in his best form last start at Port Pirie but his two runs before that were superb. If he can lob into the right position today then he is a big chance. The maiden two-year-olds kick-start the night, where CREAMY KARALTA (7) makes his debut following two impressive trial victories. He draws the outside of the front row, but looks a classy type and expect Kent Rattray to have him screwed down and ready to win first up. RYHAD (1) trialled nicely against older horses in good time recently and should take plenty of improvement from that experience, although he showed limited gate speed on that occasion. SOLO SNITCH (2) and IDEN JUST BECAUSE (8) drop back in grade after competing in recent two-year-old features and should appreciate their favourable draws, giving both every opportunity to be in the finish. POGACAR (6) and SMELL THE SMOKE (4) have both placed at the trials and look like improving types. It would be no surprise to see either take another step forward here, and they appear the best of the remainder. Selections:CREAMY KARLATA (7), SOLO SNITCH (2), IDEN JUST BECAUSE (8), RYHAD (1)

GO THE RED (2) has been a great addition to the Yole stable since arriving from Queensland and produced another handy performance in similar grade against some classy opposition last start. Expect him to be driven aggressively again here in an attempt to find the front, where he could take plenty of running down over the longer distance. ROCKANDAHARDPLACE (5) is a brilliant standing-start beginner and should find himself in the first couple after 200 metres. He should relish the longer journey and looks certain to be thereabouts. GORDONS BAY (6) comes from the 20-metre back mark but should get every opportunity in the small field to utilise his sharp finishing sprint. IRON CLAD (1) is rarely far away in races of this nature, as is COLBY SANZ (3), while WATERMELON SUGAR (4) could give a cheeky sight if he begins sharply, as he has done on a couple of occasions recently. Selections:GO THE RED (2), ROCKANDAHARDPLACE (5), GORDONS BAY (6), IRON CLAD (1)

The maidens again go at it looking to break their duck, with several runners knocking on the door. CHARLI PIPPEN (5) continues to threaten to break through but has kept finding one better. Expect him to settle just off the speed with cover and get another opportunity to finish strongly. LIFE ONA HIGHWAY (3) will no doubt look to attempt an all-the-way victory, as he has done on several occasions recently, while LITTLE CAPPUCCINA (2) should also settle handy on the pegs and has not been far away of late. QUARTEIRA (7) is a well-bred three-year-old colt closely related to the champion Beautide and should continue to improve with further race experience. Recent mainland arrivals DIAMONDONTHEROCKS (8) and ROBUST SALLY (9) should be competitive in a maiden of this nature. DEMON DESTROYER (6) has changed stables and, although he has clearly had some gait issues throughout his short career, he was seen making nice ground in a trial earlier this week. If he brings his best manners and form to race night, he could be right in the finish. Selections:CHARLI PIPPEN, LIFE ONA HIGHWAY (3), DEMON DESTROYER (6), LITTLE CAPPUCCINA (2)

An even field where the three-year-olds A DRAGON FOR JOE (3) and OMYBACNKNEES JUDGE (2) will be looking to take advantage of their favourable front-row draws after some handy performances of late. Expect KEAYANG LEXI (1) to attempt to control the race from the front, while IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (4) should also be driven forward from the gate. That should give the three-year-olds their opportunity to secure positions on speed with cover and be right in the finish. JET TO HEAVEN (10) makes his Tasmanian debut for the visiting stable and brings handy enough mainland form to be competitive in a race of this nature. It wouldn't surprise to see any of the remaining runners bob up and earn a cheque for connections in what looks a very even affair. Selections A DRAGON FOR JOE (3), OMYBACNKNEES JUDGE (2), IFYOULOVEME LETMEGO (4), JET TO HEAVEN (10)

A competitive field with plenty of consistent performers engaged, where MUZZA MEMATE (4) is racing in career-best form. He can still be a nervous watch for punters and occasionally does something wrong, but clearly possesses the most ability in this field when at his best. Expect him to push forward from the draw, as will EVERYTHING BUT THE (2), who has been super consistent of late and may be able to find the pegs, where he could take plenty of running down and looks a danger. DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (1) is always thereabouts in this grade and should again get his opportunity from a position on speed. MONEYS NO ISSUE (9) was spotted hitting the line strongly last start and should be running home well again, while MOVESLIKEALADY (12) will no doubt be doing similar from the wide back-row draw, as she usually does when saved for one run. JOHN VINCENT (10) is an interesting runner arriving from South Australia and looks to possess plenty of speed, so the market may be the best guide to his chances first up in the state. Selections:MUZZAMEMATE (4), EVERYTHING BUT THE (2), DIDYALOUSAROOSTA (1)MONEYS NO ISSUE (9)

The low-class event of the night is an extremely open affair. Expect PARK LANE (4) to use his sharp gate speed in an attempt to find the front, where he could give a cheeky sight at odds over the short distance and looks a potential improver. SHEEZA SOHO (1) should enjoy a nice run in transit behind the expected speed and gets her chance to notch up another victory, being the least-experienced runner in the field. JEREMY WELLS (5) and GOBSMACKED (7) should be running home strongly, as they usually do in races of this nature. COUNT YOUR BLESSIN (2) gets his opportunity to improve from a favourable draw, while HORRIE OTARA (3) and CHRIS BE QUICK (6) should again run their usual honest races. Selections:SHEEZA SOHO (1), PARK LANE (4), COUNT YOUR BLESSIN (2), GOBSMACKED (7)

ATOMIC BLACK (1) possesses good gate speed and gets his chance to return to the winner's circle from the pole draw over the short trip. LOU BABY (4) should appreciate the smaller field and gets his opportunity to settle on speed and show his class after two handy performances since returning from a lengthy spell. He should now be nearing peak fitness. LYNRYD SKYNRYD (7) could be the fly in the ointment from a speed-map perspective if he is used aggressively from the gate, as he often is. ANOTHER NIEN (9) gets a nice trailing draw and is rarely far away in races of this nature. If there is genuine early speed, that should also suit SNOWIEWILLREV (2), who was an easy winner last start when coming off a hot tempo, albeit in weaker grade. He should receive another nice run in transit and be finishing off strongly. Likewise, VANQUISH STRIDE (3) can never be ruled out in this grade. Selections:ATOMIC BLACK (1), LOU BABY (4), SNOWIEWILLREV (2), VANQUISH STRIDE (3)

WEE GEORGIE WOOD (1) will be looking to take advantage of getting back to a favourable draw and gets his chance to return to the winner's circle. He can be a little touchy behind the mobile, however, so will need to bring his best manners, particularly with ART HUNTSMAN (4) likely to use his sharp gate speed in an attempt to find the pegs early. He has returned to his best form of late and continues to race very consistently. WATCH YOUR BACK (5) got the gaps at the right time when winning last start and gets his opportunity to make it back-to-back victories in this even field. IMA LITTLE NEEDY (3) should find a position on speed with cover and gets his chance after competing well in recent four-year-old features, with this representing somewhat of a drop in class. The four Wayne Yole-trained runners can never be ruled out in races of this nature, with CAN FEEL THE FURY (6) looking the pick of them after returning to his best form in recent starts. He went forward at the start then was shuffled back on the markers mid-race at his latest Cambridge performance. OVERVIEW: PURPLE MOON (2) will appreciate a big drop back in class on her latest fourth in a $50,000 event at Menangle on July 04. OVERVIEW: DAISY STARZZZ (10) worked hard at various stages of the event and battled on fairly well for fourth at Cranbourne last week. She should be fitter after having two starts since October 2023 and looms as one of the leading chances. BETTING ATTACK (6) began quickly and attempted to lead throughout when third behind Just Like Nugget at Charlton last week. He is a good chance of finding the lead again and this race is no harder. She went well enough first up to suggest she should be competitive against this line up. SELECTIONS: DAISY STARZZZ (10), BETTING ATTACK (6), MAHEO (4), KAIDENBOY (2)

OVERVIEW:SMOKING SHANNON (1) made a big impression at her Victorian debut as she led throughout and blitzed her rivals in a mile rate of 1.55.7 at Shepparton. She is drawn to lead again and will take catching. ASMILEANDAWINX (7) is dropping back in class from her recent efforts at Metropolitan level and is capable of improving on her numerical form. Her third placed effort behind Keayang Payton in a mile rate of 1.54.1 is a good form pointer for this event. OLIVIA ROSE (5) is an interesting runner. She hasn’t started since sprinting sharply down the back straight and sustaining the run to score impressively at Terang in December. She has a tricky draw first up but is too good to dismiss. OPTIMAL (3) finished off quickly from midfield on the markers when third behind the smart pacer Secret Service Agent at Geelong and is not without a chance. SELECTIONS: SMOKING SHANNON (1), ASMILEANDAWINX (7), OLIVIA ROSE (5), OPTIMAL (3)

OVERVIEW:KYVALLEY MISTY (11) is resuming since a disappointing last of nine at Bendigo in June. She was placed behind Mista Walker from the standing start at Cranbourne on May 24 and she finished second at a recent Kilmore trial performance so she is worth thought against this line up. SUZYS DREAM (7) was heavily supported ($1-45 fav) and faded after racing without cover at Kilmore last outing. She is dropping back into a suitable class and gets her chance to improve on her numerical form. BETSY ANNE (8) will appreciate a drop back in class from her past three attempts and she was runner up behind the in-form trotter Champagnes on July 23 so she is worth an investment. CHARLIE WALKER (10) is resuming since a third at Ballarat in May. He is usually competitive against this class and will go close if he is somewhere near his peak. SELECTIONS: KYVALLEY MISTY (11), SUZYS DREAM (7), BETSY ANNE (8), CHARLIE WALKER (10)

OVERVIEW: THE FIERY SUNSET (2) hasn’t had a great deal of luck at her past few outings and performs best when she is close to the pace so she gets her chance to improve from the good draw. She defeated Pique and Silent Reverie (won since) at a Geelong victory on July 03. MAJOR MAX (10) was having his first run in a month when he was able to run home best and defeat Love Who (won since) at Kilmore. His manners frequently let him down but he is a strong chance if he delivers another fool proof display. NIGHT SKY (3) has performed below her best form in two starts back from a break but she has been competitive against stronger grade previously and she should be getting fitter. WHATSTHEGOSS (9) was in a striking position but broke stride at the 300m when unplaced at Maryborough last outing. He is racing better than his form reads and is worth thought. LOUIEVILLE LASS (4) and BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (6) are both capable of showing up without surprising. If the emergency MASSIF CENTRAL (5) gains a start, he should be in front for a long way. SELECTIONS: THE FIERY SUNSET (2), MAJOR MAX (10), NIGHT SKY (3), WHATSTHEGOSS (9)

OVERVIEW: MUSKEE (11) is new to the standing start but he will take beating if he begins safely. He finished fast to score at Melton two starts ago then followed with a third behind the very smart trotter Alrighty. ANTONOV (6) boasts very consistent form from behind the tapes and is versatile. He made a mid-race move and parked without cover when a game second behind John’s Boy last outing. JUST AS I AM (8) lacks standing start experience but has been racing against strong opposition and should be competitive if he can trot away in the desired manner. JACK SPRAT (9) is a strong type and worked forward to find the lead when he scored at Melton two starts ago. He will be suited if there is a genuine tempo throughout. WATCH AND ACT (1) and MAESTRO (10) are both standing start specialists and cannot be left out of calculations. OVERVIEW: DONA AMALIA (10) struck trouble and lost his chance when seventh at Kilmore last outing. He finished off strongly when a game second behind Jilliby Topgun prior so he appears to be hard to beat against this line up. POPPY POPSTAR (9) tired after racing without cover at Kilmore last outing but she was a big winner at Maryborough when working hard in the run prior and she has won five races under similar conditions this season. RASTAMON (4) is a fast beginner and will take catching if he is able to find the lead. He attempted to lead early, ended up being behind the leader from the 1300m and finished in fourth at Ballarat last week. VAN DOREN (2) is trotting consistently and is drawn to gain a trail just off the speed. He is worth thought along with MORNING DOVE (5), QUEEN TRUSCOTT (7) and BLACK AND GOLD (11). BACK: DONA AMALIA (10) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: DONA AMALIA (10), POPPY POPSTAR (9), RASTAMON (4), VAN DOREN (2)

OVERVIEW:JUST INCREDIBLE (6) is racing in great form and looms as the horse to beat. He worked hard in the run and went down fighting when a brave second behind the smart pacer Don Crunch at Mildura on August 07. STARVIN MARVIN (2) began quickly to lead and held off his rivals to win at Mildura two weeks ago and is a good chance of finding the lead again so he cannot be dismissed. CALF PEN (1) is racing well below his best form but this is his best draw for some time and he is a possible improver. CAULONIA TERROR (3) came from last and hit the line strongly for fourth behind Cheers Poverty last week. He has recently dropped down into this class and went well enough last week to warrant consideration. HELLAVA DEAL (4) will be fitter from her first up run since May and has the ability to show up prominently. BACK: JUST INCREDIBLE (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: JUST INCREDIBLE (6), STARVIN MARVIN (2), CALF PEN (1), CAULONIA TERROR (3)

He did well when he last competed locally and he won a trial on Monday night so a bold showing would not surprise. HESASTAR (5) pushed forward to race without cover and battled on fairly for fourth at Mildura last outing. This is a race of more depth but he is drawn to go well again. BACK: SNEAKY PHILTRA (7) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SNEAKY PHILTRA (7), ACCELERE (4), HESASTAR (5), PUNTO CALIENTE (1)

He should strip fitter from that run and has the best draw out of the major chances so he warrants respect. DON LOU (5) made a good impression at his first run since coming from Queensland and will prove hard to beat again. He settled down midfield, came out four horses wide on the home turn and produced a big finish to defeat a field of similar standard. HOT DEAL (6) was a game winner over Ultimate Vinnie at Horsham prior to a close second behind DON LOU (5). MAXY WANTS TO PLAY (1) will appreciate his best draw for some time and he has won several races under these conditions at Mildura previously so he is worth a ticket each way. She is a promising filly and appears to be well placed against this class. CAPTIVATE ME (5) led out then took cover when second behind My Ultimate Henry last week. He is a good chance of finding the lead despite his wide draw and he should prove hard to catch. CRUEL MISTRESS (1) was headed off at the start and moved away from the markers to race without cover from the 1500m when third under similar conditions last week. She is ideally drawn and is not without a chance. ULTIMATE ADVICE (6) is widely drawn but should have benefited from the experience of her debut performance last week and is worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: YOU’VE BEEN SERVED (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: YOU’VE BEEN SERVED (7), CAPTIVATE ME (5), CRUEL MISTRESS (1), ULTIMATE ADVICE (6)

WATCH THE ATTITUDE (5) produced a career best performance when she led throughout in a mile rate of 1.56.5 two weeks ago then followed with a second behind King Saint last week. She is likely to give a forward showing from her reasonable draw. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (6) is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward and is racing consistently against this class so she is worth a ticket each way. SELECTIONS: LETSGO BIG GIRL (7), WATCH THE ATTITUDE (5), BIGBASHASH (4), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (6)

OVERVIEW:KEAYANG CRIPPA (4) progressed forward to race without cover and battled on fairly well for fourth behind Punto Caliente seven days ago. He is racing in good form and is a chance of finding the lead from his reasonable draw so he should prove hard to beat. EGBERT (5) is another fast beginner drawn on the front line and is working back into his peak form. He came from midfield and finished off well for a close second behind Punto Caliente last week. ALIENFROMARMSTRONG (8) was heavily supported and attempted to lead throughout when a disappointing sixth at Mildura last week. He was held up for a run at a vital stage when second prior and he came from off the speed to win at Mildura on July 10 so he is worth another chance. MAJOR LINCOLN (7) was placed in two attempts at Mildura back in 2021/22 and is returning from a long stay in the Sunshine State. He hasn’t been in the best of form of late but he does strike a suitable assignment first up for trainer Tori Hutchins. BACK: KEAYANG CRIPPA (4) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: KEAYANG CRIPPA (4), EGBERT (5), ALIENFROMARMSTRONG (8), MAJOR LINCOLN (7)

OVERVIEW: WHITEHAVEN BEACH (7) broke through for a deserved victory at Mildura last week, where he progressed forward to find the lead and kicked on too well in the run to the finish. He is awkwardly drawn but is one of the leading chances again. BAZZAS LEGACY (8) will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and has been placed in three of his past four starts. He enjoyed a nice trail throughout but held his own in reasonable time when second behind Cheers Poverty last week. THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (2) is a fast beginner and led throughout to win at Mildura two starts ago. He pressured the leader throughout and did extremely well for third last week so he must be considered as a winning chance again. SHES POPPY (9) is also dropping back in class for this assignment and has the speed to be in the finish. She chased hard when second in a slick mile rate of 1.56.5 at Mildura two starts ago. SELECTIONS: WHITEHAVEN BEACH (7), BAZZAS LEGACY (8), THE DEVIL ROLLS ON (2), SHES POPPY (9)

OVERVIEW: Plenty of hopes to kick-off the night of racing at Melton, but FREAK OUT (9) looks to find a suitable assignment in what is a slight drop in grade from recent outings. He was only beaten 14.7m in a slick 1:54.7 mile rate last time behind Foregone Conclusion and had similar margins in two runs before that after winning from the front in a 41-45 ratings event at Melton. This is an easier 0-41 clash and he should run well from nine. The Glenn Bull runners FAVOURITEHIGHLIGHT (8), who draws for a good trip behind speedy beginner OHHEMMJAY CRESCO (1), and SHEZABLUECHIP (3), who has been brave despite tough trips her past couple, look good chances, while GOODTIME MAE (6) is among a host of others that wouldn’t surprise with the right trip. Tough start! SELECTIONS: FREAK OUT (9), FAVOURITEHIGHLIGHT (8), SHEZABLUECHIP (3), GOODTIME MAE (6)

OVERVIEW: Another race where you can make a case for quite a few, but siding with KYVALLEY MICHAEL (9) from the back row. He looks to be the horse contesting the best races of late, and he has been very competitive in doing so. He had no real chance last weekend when settling at the tail in a race won by leader Vici Bloom, but before that sat parked and only went down 4.6m to Sky Flair, who has won again since. That was in a 0-75 ratings race, and this is a drop back to a 56-64 event. The in-form DISTANT SUN (7) is a good chance despite the wide gate. He was a big winner two starts back for Blake Pace when unleashing a great turn of foot to run down Ox Knox at Kilmore, and was very brave when second to SEBASTIANS WAITING (8) at the same track when bringing up the running line from near the tail on August 6. The latter ruined his chances of back-to-back wins when galloping early last start but was only beaten 11.2m and is a handy type, while SCAR (4) might be a chance to get down to the fence and perhaps heads the rest of the winning chances. BACK: KYVALLEY MICHAEL (9) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS: KYVALLEY MICHAEL (9), DISTANT SUN (7), SEBASTIANS WAITING (8), SCAR (4)

OVERVIEW: Such a hard race to map over the 1200m, but PISTOL PEARCE (5) might have the early toe to cross at the start and from there would take a lot of beating across a distance where the fence is gold. He’s certainly no superstar, but he did lead and win here at Melton last time out and also at Geelong in a slick last half on June 19. BULLETPROOF KID (2) has been runner-up his past three and looks a logical danger, while HITCH TO HIS STAR (9) and HITTHEROADJACK (8) are probably the class factors but have awkward draws to navigate. Both have good form around nice horses at Melton on a Saturday night and can certainly win if the tempo is frantic up top, as can HIGHLANDHARTBREAKA (7). SELECTIONS: PISTOL PEARCE (5), BULLETPROOF KID (2), HITCH TO HIS STAR (9), HITTHEROADJACK (8)

OVERVIEW: MISS MUSCLE (5) is a two-year-old trotter up against mostly older horses, but looks fairly smart and might be able to add a second career win to her resume. She won in good style at Melton two starts back and then chased home the very handy Phoenix Rex for third after that, getting close to Regal Gala who has won since. THE CHOOK (1) draws for a nice trip, and while disappointing as favourite last time out at Kilmore, has run some good races prior and looks a threat. SHES SKY HIGH (8) should lob a nice spot on the fence and is dropping back in grade a shade, while DREAMS OF LOVE (2) looks a chance of crossing down to the fence where she would run a good race second-up from a break. HOLD THAT MAGIC (9) has trialled okay since her last run and is one to factor in for wider exotics, and while two-year-old MAJARO GIRL (3) might start well in the market, I haven’t been overly taken by her two runs for the Andy Gath yard. BACK: MISS MUSCLE (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: MISS MUSCLE (5), THE CHOOK (1), SHES SKY HIGH (8), DREAMS OF LOVE (2)

OVERVIEW: Looks plenty of speed off the front line here and it won’t be easy for THE FINAL DANCE (1), but he has started odds-on in all four runs since joining the Emma Stewart stable and won two of them in good style. The defeats had excuses, including last time over 1200m when he was crossed at the start and had to do work. He still closed well and was only beaten 5.4m by the handy Insider Trading. He’s no moral, but from the draw he goes on top. FIRE MARSHALL (10) hasn’t been seen at the trials since his last run on June 13, which was a brave death-seat fourth to the seasoned Clymenus. This followed a number of nice efforts on Saturday nights at Melton and he’s certainly a contender first-up from a freshen. TIVOLI (8) should get a nice run in behind THE FINAL DANCE (1) and is very capable in this grade, while MONTANA PRIDE (9) chased down ISTHISTHEREALLIFE (7) on August 3 and then wasn’t beaten far last time out behind Pistol Pearce. Those two are also contenders in a race where you can make a case for plenty of runners. SELECTIONS: THE FINAL DANCE (1), FIRE MARSHALL (10), TIVOLI (8), MONTANA PRIDE (9)

OVERVIEW: LENARD ESS (1) is a veteran of 195 career starts and loves the peg-line runs, which he will get here. He hasn’t done much his last couple when off the fence, but did run a nice second to the handy The Last Trip at Geelong recently and should give this a real shake from barrier one if he can do enough to boot up and perhaps take a sit on fast beginner SPUN SILVER (5). MISS PIGGY WIGGY (9) closed off okay from the rear in the race won by SPUN SILVER (5) at Melton last week and can improve on that with a different race shape over the 2240m, WOODLEA DIEGO (2) is another of the quick starters off the front line and is a winning factor, while the grey SPUN SILVER (5) is probably better suited over the shorter trips, but is flying at the moment and will give herself a chance if she can again find her favourite spot out in front. SELECTIONS: LENARD ESS (1), MISS PIGGY WIGGY (9), WOODLEA DIEGO (2), SPUN SILVER (5)

OVERVIEW: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2) has trialled really nicely at Cobram since her fourth placing here at Melton on August 7 when she made an early break but still did a great job to only be beaten 14.5m. She was only nabbed in the shadows of the post by the in-form Spirited Lass prior to that and her first-up win during July was very good. While her manners are always a concern, a faultless display will have her hard to beat, particularly if she finds the front. Great to see the return of last season’s Victorian 2YO Trotting Filly of the Year HARPERSEVEN (6), who heads into her first run as a three-year-old on the back of three trials. She won the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series final last season and must be respected in this grade. MET WITH A SHRUG (1) is going great guns for Team Murphy and chased well for second behind the smart The Preacher last time, while KEAYANG MINNESOTA (8) is two from two this campaign and is the other key winning hope alongside the unbeaten LORD LOGAN (3), who has been so impressive despite death seat trips in two wins to start his career. BACK: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: LITTLE MISS MORGAN (2), HARPERSEVEN (6), MET WITH A SHRUG (1), KEAYANG MINNESOTA (8)

OVERVIEW: FANTASY FLIGHT (8) was $1.10 favourite last time at Kilmore when he galloped early and ruined his chances at the start. Nothing went right there and we should go off his prior first-up run when he found the front, gave a great kick and was only nailed late by Bay Of Fires in good time. There was a huge margin back to third and he looks ready to break his maiden at the eighth time of asking. SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (1) was super at the trials last time out when coming from a mile back to win at Melton and looks a good chance on debut, SWEET FLORABEL (5) beat the aforementioned rival home when second at her only trial appearance on August 4 and is another that steps out on debut, while BETTER THEN DAICOS (3) showed gate speed to lead last time at Shepparton, and despite dropping out there was well fancied in the market and is best of the rest alongside ARRIVAL TIME (6). BACK: FANTASY FLIGHT (8) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: FANTASY FLIGHT (8), SWEETSUGARCANDYMAN (1), BETTER THEN DAICOS (3), SWEET FLORABEL (5)

OVERVIEW: DONNYOSKO (4) is the most experienced horse in this field of two-year-old trotters and she’s shown enough ability in her five starts to suggest she’s capable of winning a maiden this season. She broke when in a striking position during a recent trial at Maryborough, but her first-up run when fourth at the same track on August 3 was serviceable and her efforts before a spell earlier in the year were sound. SNOWIN (3) chased home race winner Rose All Day to only be beaten 4m in a trial at Kilmore and steps out on debut for the powerhouse Andy Gath yard, no vision was available for KYVALLEY DRIFTER’s (1) trial at Melton on August 11 but she won that and also hails from a strong trotting stable, while LUSTROUS (5) has been okay in a couple of trial hit-outs ahead of his debut. A race where we will learn a bit! SELECTIONS: DONNYOSKO (4), SNOWIN (3), KYVALLEY DRIFTER (1), LUSTROUS (5) 10-UNIT GAME PLAN R2 #9 KYVALLEY MICHAEL – 1 unit (win) R4 #5 MISS MUSCLE – 3 units (win) R7 #2 LITTLE MISS MORGAN – 3 units (win) R8 #8 FANTASY FLIGHT – 3 units (win) EARLY QUADDIE 2,3,4,5,6,8,9/4,7,8,9/2,5,7,8,9/5 QUADDIE 1,3,8,9,10/1,2,5,9/1,2,6,8/8 Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW: What a cracking way to start the night at Melton, with a wide-open free-for-all pacing contest where most have claims. There does appear to be plenty of tempo in this race given most of the key chances are either drawn on the back row or out wide off the front, and I’ll take a slight leaning to SIR JIMMY (10) third-up from a break. He was a dominant winner first-up from the front here on July 18 and then unleashed a sizzling 54.12 last half from the rear to run second behind stablemate The Art Of Success recently. He’s flying and has come up each-way odds, so looks a nice play. CATCH A WAVE (7) comes up with the front row draw for the first time in a campaign where he hasn’t had races run to suit and there’s a chance he presses forward and finds the front. From there, over the 1720m, he’d be a huge player. HOORAH PHILTRA (9) is airborne and continued his great form with a fast-finishing second last weekend to Fairplay, while FIGHTER COMMAND (11) returns to Melton after a Brisbane campaign where he won a heat of the Inter Dominion and ran fifth in the final. He’s a good horse. TRIPLE EIGHT (2) is one at odds that I think will run well from a good draw, while it’s great to see arguably the country’s most popular horse, BULLETPROOF BOY (12), back at the races, but he heads in without a trial and a horror draw so he’d need to produce something special. SELECTIONS: SIR JIMMY (10), CATCH A WAVE (7), HOORAH PHILTRA (9), FIGHTER COMMAND (11)

OVERVIEW: Amazing edition of the time-honoured VHRC Holmfield, where the three-year-old trotters do battle in an intriguing contest. THE PREACHER (10) was brilliant from the front at Melton when winning by a big space on August 12, which followed a big triumph in the Warragul Trotters Cup off 30m. He ran a great race to beat MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7) in a heat of the Nutrien series at Wagga before that horse overturned the result in the rich final from the top. With a nice trailing draw, he looks a good each-way play. MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7) is first-up from that Nutrien series victory and heads here on the back of a solid trial at Cobram, where he placed third. Stacey Towers will likely press forward in a bid to find the top, and he’d be very hard to beat if he got there easily. PASTOR DUNBAR (9) is the Group 1 NSW Trotters Derby champion and trialled well against the pacers ahead of his return, as did NOTANOTHA NAUGHTY (8), who is now back in the care of Hugh Cathels, the trainer for his Group 1 Redwood Classic success as a two-year-old. UNCLAD (11) and HOWDY MATE (12) head the other chances, while TIMMY WHIZ (3), BROTHER MOUNTAIN (4) and HALLEBESOFINE (5) are all factors from the front line. BACK: THE PREACHER (10) – 1 unit (each-way) SELECTIONS: THE PREACHER (10), MUNNY THE MUNSTER (7), PASTOR DUNBAR (9), NOTANOTHA NAUGHTY (8)

OVERVIEW: IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (11) was badly inconvenienced last time by galloping rivals, but still did a good job to run sixth behind the flying Alrighty, and before that looked the winner when grabbed in the shadows by Muskee. His defeat prior had excuses when he began badly and sustained a flat tyre, and the two runs in late June and early July were dominant wins. He’s going really well this campaign and looks very hard to beat in this grade. That said, there’s plenty of others with winning hopes. ALDEBARAN ABEL (5) finally had things go his way when beating RINGER WELLS (8) here on August 8, with the latter galloping in the home straight when looking a serious chance of victory. KEAYANG GYPSY (4), who was a brave fourth from the chair here last weekend and won from the top first-up from a break, is another key chance. There’s a few others that wouldn’t shock, including FREIGHT SHAKER (9), FARROKH (12), THUNDA STRUCK (10), SAM NIEN (1) and ROCKY VALLEY (2) for the late Ian Caruana, who has this race named in his honour. BACK: IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (11) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY (11), ALDEBARAN ABEL (5), KEAYANG GYPSY (4), SAM NIEN (1)

OVERVIEW: Taking a chance here on a horse I’ve got a lot of time for who needs luck in his races, and that’s TWISTING BY (6). He’s a slow beginner and will probably end up in the back half of the field, but he possesses a good turn of foot and might be able to round them up given the likely early tempo with WITH IN REASON (5) and SOHO DARKNSTORMY (7) drawn on the front row. Last start, he was held up but savaged the line for third behind Always Be Blakey in a good race and he just needs the right trip to figure. CROCODILE SOCKS (1) returned from a break with a good second to the smart mare Wicked Confession in fast time at Wagga on August 14 and draws for a nice trip in this wide-open contest. He contested some key feature races as a three-year-old last season and should run well. WITH IN REASON (5) was incredible winning from the rear at huge odds last time at Melton and will run well again, while GOOD TOBE LOCKSLEY (8) gets the draw to improve on recent runs and the talented IMA TERMINATOR (4) hits this third-up ready to fire. They head the other chances in a race where most can win. BACK: TWISTING BY (6) – 1 unit (each-way) SELECTIONS: TWISTING BY (6), CROCODILE SOCKS (1), WITH IN REASON (5), GOOD TOBE LOCKSLEY (8)

OVERVIEW: I AM THE STORM (9) looks like running a short-priced favourite here for leading trainer Emma Stewart after a strong start to the campaign that has seen three good wins and a brave fourth when doing plenty of work in a frantic race here at Melton on August 8. He was only beaten 5.8m there and never really got much peace after eventually working to the top on the back of a rapid lead time. This is suitable and he’s sure to go close. OLLIES THE BOSS (1) hasn’t won a race this preparation, but looks ready and draws for a lovely trip. He chased home the impressive Words here on August 7 and has racked up five placings from six starts this time in. GUNFORHIRE (2) was a bit plain last time at Terang, but his effort prior when fourth to Rocknroll Willow was very good from the back and he now gets the services of Ewa Justice, who has won on him before. MIGHTY JOLT (5) has been sparingly raced since joining the Dean Braun barn, but did run a cracker for second on debut for the stable back in late March when he led from this draw. Keep safe. BACK: MULTI – I AM THE STORM/VERBICI/I AM WILMA – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: I AM THE STORM (9), OLLIES THE BOSS (1), GUNFORHIRE (2), MIGHTY JOLT (5)

OVERVIEW: Awfully hard to oppose THE LAST TRIP (7), who looks a star on the rise since joining the Emma Stewart barn. He won his first two starts for the stable by 25.8m and 48.6m before taking out a heat of this series last weekend by 11.6m in good time once again. He has drawn awkward here in gate seven, but you’d anticipate Taylor Ford working forward and probably finding the front. Looks the horse to beat, but you’ll have to take the shorts. LOUGLE (1) was sensational running third in the other of the qualifiers last Saturday night. He settled towards the rear and came with a sustained three-wide run in the last lap to only miss a neck in a race won by THE NAKED ART (12), who was brilliant from the breeze. LOUGLE (1) has never drawn the front row here in Victoria, so his gate speed is a query, but he’s a nice horse and is sure to run well. PICK UP ELVIS (4) charged from the back to grab second behind THE LAST TRIP (7) and is a winning chance, while TELEMACHUS (3) might be able to run well at odds given his good gate speed and ability to find the fence. Other key runners include THE NAKED ART (12) and LILLY LOTUS (6). SELECTIONS: THE LAST TRIP (7), LOUGLE (1), PICK UP ELVIS (4), TELEMACHUS (3)

OVERVIEW: VERBICI (6) looks a very, very promising two-year-old trotter for Chris Lang and Sonia Mahar, and he resumes from a break with an undefeated record after four career starts. He won the rich Nutrien Final at Wagga easily in late May and then was a tad unimpressive when scoring in the Group 2 Trot NSW Final after that, but did sustain a flat tyre and still got the job done. He beat KYVALLEY DIABLO (4) in a trial at Melton last week and again performed well at Kilmore in a hit-out there on Tuesday. The one to beat. KYVALLEY DIABLO (4) made an early break on debut at Bendigo in June but still won in a super display, and then galloped again in that Group 2 Trot NSW Final and ruled himself out of contention. He’s trialled well recently and is the key danger. INSULATOR (1) made an early error first-up last weekend, but had trialled well prior and has shown really good ability, while REGAL GALA (5) won that aforementioned race after finding the top with his good gate speed and has been racing well all season. BACK: MULTI – I AM THE STORM/VERBICI/I AM WILMA – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: VERBICI (6), KYVALLEY DIABLO (4), INSULATOR (1), REGAL GALA (5)

OVERVIEW: I AM WILMA (5) looks as though she just needs to trot to win this final event, despite being first-up from a break. She’s a Group 1 winner that was able to claim a free-for-all last preparation and this looks a very suitable open mares trotting contest. She has trialled well with back-to-back victories at Melton and Kilmore, and you’d expect her to work to the top and win. ALDEBARAN SUE (4) won two races in Queensland during July and then didn’t have much luck back in Victoria last time when copping early interference at Kilmore. She still did well to only be beaten 10.3m and is a trotter on the rise. CENTURION DREAM (1) has good gate speed, draws well and is racing in solid form, while DICHOTOMY (6) was well beaten first-up behind Alrighty, but has won 11 career races and has competed at a good level in the past. BACK: MULTI – I AM THE STORM/VERBICI/I AM WILMA – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: I AM WILMA (5), ALDEBARAN SUE (4), CENTURION DREAM (1), DICHOTOMY (6) 10-UNIT GAME PLAN R2 #10 THE PREACHER – 1 unit (each-way) R3 #11 IJUSTCALLEDTOSAY – 2 units (win) R4 #6 TWISTING BY – 1 unit (each-way) MULTI – I AM THE STORM/VERBICI/I AM WILMA – 4 units (win) EARLY QUADDIE 4,7,9,10,11,12/7,8,9,10/4,5,11/1,2,5,6,8 QUADDIE 1,2,5,9/7/6/5 Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

MACH ASSASSIN (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. The last time he was able to lead he scored a good win at this track over the 1780. He should lead and be hard to run down. STUDLEIGH MARK (7) should get a good run through behind the leader in this race which was the same run as last time out which saw him use the sprint lane to run down Docta Feelgood. He should run well again. ROLL TO THE TOP (4) had things go wrong last time out when checked and was still able to go close to winning there when finishing third behind Captain Jazz. She may be shuffled back early and can be running on late. REAL TIN TIN (10) secured a good run behind the leader last time out and was able to run second to Mullum Doc. He may get shuffled back early in this race and should be running on late. SELECTIONS: MACH ASSASSIN (1), STUDLEIGH MARK (7), ROLL TO THE TOP (4), REAL TIN TIN (10) SUGGESTED BET: MACH ASSASSIN (1) to win.

ALTA SENSATION (1) has been racing in good form and looks likely to have the speed to drive through and lead this race. He led last time out at Albion Park and was just run down late by Mullum Ruby who returned to form there when using the sprint lane to score. CHARGE AHEAD (9) has been racing without a lot of luck in strong company and appears to be dropping back in grade into this race. He drew wide last time out and was shuffled a long way back there in a race which was dominated by horses up on speed. OUR ULTIMATE JESSY (8) raced without luck last time out at Albion Park when being held up at a crucial stage in a race taken out by Sweet Dior. She looks likely to get a good run off the speed again and should be running on late. VINCHESKA (4) has impressed since joining the stable of Donny Smith. She led two starts ago and was able to hold off Amylee before racing with less luck last time out at this track. SELECTIONS: ALTA SENSATION (1), CHARGE AHEAD (9), OUR ULTIMATE JESSY (8), VINCHESKA (4) SUGGESTED BET: ALTA SENSATION (1) to win.

MUCH BETTOR (1) was shuffled back last time out and appeared to run through the line nicely late at Albion Park over the 2138. He should have the speed to drive through and lead in this race and should be hard to run down. ROCKIN SWEET (7) should get a good run through in this race behind the likely leader. He was able to lead recently at Marburg and held off Mach Assassin late to score there. He should get every chance. PRETTY LITTLE LIAR (3) put in an excellent run two starts ago when sitting without cover at Albion Park finishing third behind Mullum Doc. She may be left to do some work again in this race but should still be thereabouts. STUDLEIGH ANNE (8) comes into this race first up since April which looks a query. She should get a good run off the speed and can be running into it late. SELECTIONS: MUCH BETTOR (1), ROCKIN SWEET (7), PRETTY LITTLE LIAR (3), STUDLEIGH ANNE (8) SUGGESTED BET: MUCH BETTOR (1) to win.

FAVREAU (6) was forced to race without cover last time out at this track and trip and proved too good there for Threentwo. He looks likely to get a similar type of run again in this race and should be hard to beat. MY SCIMITAR (10) didn’t have much luck last time out in a race taken out by Prospectus at Albion Park over the 2138. He should get a good run off the speed and can be running into it late. AZOR AHAI (7) scored a dominant win in a recent trial running home a nice last half for this type of race. He draws awkwardly inside the back row but can figure with luck in running at the right time. BEAU STEELE (3) draws to find a prominent position in this. He was caught wide last time out and was well beaten there but his best is good enough to figure in a race of this nature. SELECTIONS: FAVREAU (6), MY SCIMITAR (10), AZOR AHAI (7), BEAU STEELE (3) SUGGESTED BET: MYSCIMITAR (10) each way.

MAHINDI (7) was forced to race without cover when well beaten last start in a strong field of mares at Albion Park. She steps right back in grade but does draw a touch awkwardly inside the back row. She looks hardest to beat. KERBANG (1) hasn’t been racing at his best in recent outings including last start when getting back and running on just fairly. He draws better this time and may be able to lead early. IDEAL ASSASSIN (3) should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. She wasn’t beaten too far last time out behind Rick Reilly after racing off the speed there. ROCK HAMMER (5) was able to break through for another win last time out when coming from off the speed to score in a race the leaders set a genuine tempo. He should get a good run off the speed again and can be running into it late. SELECTIONS: MAHINDI (7), KERBANG (1), IDEAL ASSASSIN (3), ROCK HAMMER (5) SUGGESTED BET: MAHINDI (7) to win.

PERFECT FEELING (1) has good gate speed and looks the leader in this race in the early stages. He raced without luck last time out when locking wheels over this track and trip. He should be hard to run down. THE HARRIS HAWK (6) should get a good run off the speed in this race and has been racing in good form. He got back in the run from a wide draw last time out and was running on well late into fourth. He should be hard to hold out. JUKEBOX JET (7) should get a good run through in this race behind a gate speed horse. He got back last time out and was running on late in a race taken out by Shez A Warrior. He should run well again. WELL SAID NUGGET (10) got back in the run last time out in a much stronger race and wasn’t able to get into that race late. He appears to be dropping in class in this race and could appreciate a genuine tempo. SELECTIONS: PERFECT FEELING (1), THE HARRIS HAWK (6), JUKEBOX JET (7), WELL SAID NUGGET (10) SUGGESTED BET: JUKEBOX JET (7) each way.

SAINT LOUIS BEAT (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in this race. He led last start and appeared to have the race won there before being run down very late by Downtown Manhattan. He should run well again. THREE MACHS (7) looks set to get a good run through early in this race on a horse which is likely to be keen to lead. She got back in the run last time out after being caught wide and was running on late into fifth. She should be suited in this field from a good draw. MADAM WEST (8) was running on late into second behind Bokhari at this track after getting a good run off the speed. She looks fairly well graded and can be running into the finish if the race is run to suit. JILLIBY PANDA (2) showed gate speed last time out before being shuffled back and couldn’t run on late. He steps back into a slightly easier race and should bounce back. SELECTIONS: SAINT LOUIS BEAT (1), THREE MACHS (7), MADAM WEST (8), JILLIBY PANDA (2) SUGGESTED BET: SAINT LOUIS BEAT (1) to win.

UNJUST ENRICHMENT (1) was able to drop in leaders back last time out at this track and battled away well enough there for sixth behind Yippe Kiyay. He should find this much easier than his latest outing and draws ideally in this race. IAM HUGO (8) took on a strong race last time out which was taken out by Ideal Bronski at this track over the 2138. He drew poorly there and got back in the run and wasn’t able to get into the race. He drops back in grade and draws to do no work early. CARLY PEREZ (6) trialled up nicely recently when finding the front and taking them all the way. She draws wide in this race but should be able to press forward early and if she finds the front she is likely to be hard to run down. DEAL IT VINNIE (7) won an easier race last time out at Marburg after having very little luck in running there. He trialled reasonably recently and should be ready to run well on return. SELECTIONS: UNJUST ENRICHMENT (1), IAM HUGO (8), CARLY PEREZ (6), DEAL IT VINNIE (7) SUGGESTED BET: IAM HUGO (8) to win.
